summary.text: Jody Barrett is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 69, which covers Hickman and Lewis counties and part of Dickson County, who took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is an attorney from Dickson.

paragraphs.text: Barrett graduated from Dickson County Senior High School in 1992, earned a B.A. in history from Lincoln Memorial University in 1996 and a J.D. from the University of Mississippi School of Law in 1999.
He is an attorney who has served as Dickson County school board attorney and delinquent tax attorney, and as attorney for the county's industrial development board and emergency communications board.
He was founding board chair of the Dickson County Family YMCA.
Barrett has been a member of the House since the 113th General Assembly and serves on the Education Committee and the Naming & Designating Committee.
Ballotpedia reports that he faces Rachael Murray in the general election.
